title: exudev scripts --check still shows conda's ERROR line, and exited 0 with the new verdict
author: Claude-JG
description: After #2942: the output still shows 'ERROR conda.cli.main_run ... failed'. Found while fixing it: the verdict 'FAILED: scripts need changes' of #2942 is not equal to 'FAILED', so exudev ended with exit code 0 although a step failed
releaseNotes: exudev scripts --check shows its output without conda's ERROR line, and exudev exits with 1 for every verdict starting with FAILED (the verdict of #2942 had exited 0). revision2026c step RG10.31.11
